3558-5006-5256-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-5256-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

586-864-3125-6798-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-6798-7396.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7737-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2122-7737-7803.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Brad Boimler
Repeat.

341-1594-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-4871-6026-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3499-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3499-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3499-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-6321-6723-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6723-7296.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7454.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eager Glyphmage, adding {C}{C}.
When Eager Glyphmage dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Eager Glyphmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Eager Glyphmage enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4369-5905.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4369-5905.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Warleader's Call triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

997-4053-7134--145.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-3470-6763-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3767-3918-5527-7040.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
3767-3918-5527-7040.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1661-5051-5078-5268.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

678-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Marketback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
7-3054-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4772-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4067-4477-5116-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-2438.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-2438.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

147-1418-4176-4499.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{R}{R} available if Dualcaster Mage is in your hand, or {4}{U} otherwise
147-1418-4176-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
147-1418-4176-4499.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting Karn's ability.
Holding priority, if Dualcaster Mage is in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{R}{R}.
If Dualcaster Mage is on the battlefield, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 4.
If you control four or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, which can be used to copy Vantress Visions infinitely targeting any other abilities on the stack, or to blink any number of creatures infinitely.

862-2218-4763-5147.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Crimson Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

575-1511-3510.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
575-1511-3510.description:
Activate Vitaspore Thallid's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling, targeting itself.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Repeat.

2060-2893-4482-4690-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Plant" chosen with Conspiracy.
2060-2893-4482-4690-4875.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Phylath's second ability triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on Fertilid and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2563-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control with an egg counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
2563-3259-4068.description:
Declare Xira and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Xira triggers, putting an egg counter on any other creature you control.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Xira.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control with an egg counter on it, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Xira triggers, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-4213-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Hankyu attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4213-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, putting an aim counter on Hankyu.
Repeat.
Once Hankyu has infinite aim counters, you may use Emmara to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-1644-5033.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control lands that tap to add at least {2}{G}{G}.
1401-1644-5033.description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{G}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding a card to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tatyova triggers once for each of them, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.

703-5291.notablePrerequisites: Cursed Mirror cannot be copying a creature.
703-5291.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of Cursed Mirror that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Choose to have the Cursed Mirror tokens enter the battlefield as copies of Astral Dragon.
The Cursed Mirror tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Cursed Mirror trigger, creating two token copies of any applicable permanent that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other colors and types.
Resolve the second Cursed Mirror trigger, creating two token copies of the nontoken Cursed Mirror that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 3.

510-3359-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
Mistmoon Griffin dies, triggering itself and Hofri Ghostforge.
Resolve the Hofri Ghostforge trigger, exiling Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Mistmoon Griffin that has "When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to your graveyard".
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Mistmoon Griffin token.
The Mistmoon Griffin token dies, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin token's trigger granted by Hofri Ghostforge, returning Mistmoon Griffin from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the other Mistmoon Griffin trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 5, dealing 2 damage to any target(s).
Repeat.
